 Villarreal vs. Getafe - Head-to-head record
 Villarreal have historically enjoyed the better of this fixture, winning 27 of their 49 previous meetings with Getafe. The Madrid-based side has recorded 10 victories, while the remaining encounters ended in draws.
 However, the most recent meetings have been relatively competitive. Getafe won 2-1 when the sides last met in February 2026, while Villarreal claimed a 2-0 home victory in December 2025. The Yellow Submarine also won 2-1 away from home in March 2025.
 The hosts will therefore be looking to reassert their advantage in this fixture, although Getafe can take confidence from their latest victory over Villarreal.

 Villarreal - Looking for home comfort
 Let’s take a closer look at Villarreal’s current situation. In the following sections, we will analyse their latest results and tactical approach, as well as the expected Villarreal vs. Getafe lineups.
 Recent form
 Villarreal currently sit ninth in La Liga, with three wins, three draws and five defeats from their opening 11 matches. Inigo Perez’s side have struggled for consistency, winning only one of their last four league games.
 Their latest outings have been particularly disappointing . After losing 1-0 at home to Espanyol last weekend, the Yellow Submarine suffered a 6-0 defeat to Paris Saint-Germain in the Champions League on Tuesday. They will now be under pressure to respond in front of their own supporters.
 Villarreal have also found victories hard to come by at the Estadio de la Cerámica, winning just one of their five home league matches this season. Nevertheless, they have shown greater attacking promise recently, including a 2-1 victory over Valencia and a 5-0 win against Manacor in the Copa del Rey.
 The hosts have several fitness concerns ahead of Sunday’s match. Alassane Diatta is out for an extended period with a serious hamstring injury, while Gerard Moreno, Juan Foyth and Ilias Akhomach are doubts. Pape Gueye returns after serving a suspension, and Nathan Saliba is available again following a knock.

 Getafe - Struggling on the road
 Let’s analyse Getafe’s current situation. We will review the team’s momentum, their recent results, and the standout players for the trip to Villarreal.
 Recent form
 Getafe are 13th in the La Liga table, with the same record as Villarreal after 11 matches: three wins, three draws and five defeats. José Bordalás’s side have shown some encouraging signs recently, winning two of their last three games before Thursday’s European defeat.
 Their most recent league outing was a convincing 3-1 victory over Sevilla, while they also beat Lebrijana 3-2 in the Copa del Rey. However, they were beaten 4-0 by Athletic Bilbao before those victories and then suffered a 5-2 home defeat to Lugano in the Conference League.
 Getafe’s attacking output remains a major concern. They have scored only eight goals in 11 league matches , the joint-lowest total in the division. Their inability to score consistently could prove costly against a Villarreal side looking to regain confidence.
 The visitors have fewer injury concerns than their opponents, although Christantus Uche remains unavailable and Juanmi and Zaid Romero are doubts. Enes Ünal is expected to return to the starting line-up. Dani Carvajal should also come back into the side at right-back.

 Predictions for Villarreal vs. Getafe - Hosts to Win
 Villarreal will be desperate to overcome their recent struggles at home, and this is the perfect opportunity. Getafe has lost all five away league games this season without scoring, so backing “Villarreal to win at half-time” could be a good choice.
 The visitors have conceded 12 goals on the road, highlighting a fragile defence that Villarreal’s attack should exploit from the start. With this in mind, the “Over 0.5 Goals” in the first half market looks like a very realistic possibility for this match.
 Given Getafe’s dreadful away form and Villarreal’s need to bounce back in front of their fans, our main prediction is a home victory .
